 94-B/1, Pearl One, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore 
 Email: legal@zameen.com 
 
 Or to such other address as either Party shall specify by written notice to the other Party. If either Party fails to notify the other Party of change of address then notice shall be deemed to have been delivered to the address stated above. Notice shall be deemed to have been delivered: 
 
 23.2 All Notices given pursuant to this Article shall be deemed to have been given ( i ) if delivered by hand on the date of delivery or on the date that delivery was refused by the addressee, (ii) if delivered by registered mail or by courier, on the date of delivery as established by the return receipt or courier service confirmation (or the date on which the return receipt or courier service confirms that acceptance of delivery was refused by the addressee) , or (iii) if sent by email, twenty-four (24) hours after sending the email . 
 
 
 ARTICLE XXIV 
 FRANCHISE MARKS AND INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY 
 
 24.1 Franchise Marks : The Franchisee shall use the Franchise Marks only for the operation of the Hotel franchised hereunder at the Premises ’ specified places . The Franchisee shall not use any Franchise Marks in connection with any other business activity or in any other government application without the written consent of the Franchisor. The Franchisee shall not use the Franchise Marks to incur any obligation or indebtness on behalf of the Franchisor. If litigation involving the Franchise Marks is instituted or threatened against the Franchisor, the Franchisee shall promptly notify the Franchisor in writing. The Franchise e shall not directly or indirectly contest the validity of the ownership of the Franchise Marks. The Franchise Marks are the exclusive property of the Franchisor and the Franchisee shall not have any right, claim or interest on the Franchise Marks. Upon Termination of this Agreement, the Franchisee shall immediately stop use of the Franchised Mark in relation to in respect of operation or business of the Hotel or for any other purpose whatsoever. The Franchisor shall have the sole discretion of changing its Franchise Marks without consulting the Franchisee and any such change shall automatically bind the Franchisee for implement ation, provided however, that the Franchisee shall be given prior written notice of such change . The Franchisee shall not, during the Term or thereafter, without Franchisor written consent make available any information of the Agreement to any third party. 
 
 24.2 Computer Software and Equipment: The Franchisee at its own expense shall install and maintai n at the Hotel all the equipment, Software and licenses necessary (as may be specified by the Franchisor in writing ) for the Hotel ’s Property Management System and implementing the procedures recommended by the Franchisor for operating the Hotel . At Franchisee ’s request , the Franchisor shall provide the Franchisee with equipment specifications and all required software for such Property Management System. The Franchisee shall also install at its cost any future enhancements, additions, substitutions or other modifications to such equipment and Software which are either current requirement or specified by the Franchisor and applicable to the hotels ’ Chain . The Franchisee shall also be responsible for all the costs for connecting the Hotel ’s reservation system to the Franchisor ’s central reservation system. All Software is and shall remain the exclusive property of the Franchisor or any one of its Franchisor Affiliate Entities (or the licensor of such Software, as the case may be), and the Franchisee shall have no right to use, or to copy, any Software. Upon Termination, the Franchisor shall have the right to remove from the Hotel, without compensation to the Franchisee, all Software, and any computer equipment which is utilized as part of the centralized Property Management System or is otherwise considered proprietary by the Fra nchisor, except any software , equipment, and/or licenses which are owned by the Franchisee . 
 
 24.3 Intellectual Property All Intellectual Property and Franchise Marks, shall at all times be proprietary to the Franchisor or the Franchisor Affiliate Entity(s) and shall be the exclusive property of the Franchisor or the Franchisor Affiliate Entity(s). Upon Termination, all Intellectual Property and Franchise Marks shall be removed from the Hotel by the Franchisor, without compensation to the Franchisee. 
 
 24.4 Books and records: A ll books and records maintained with respect to the Hotel, including guest records and employee records, shall be the sole property of the Franchisee but may be used by the Franchisor during the Term as provided in Clause 16.1 . 
 
 
 ARTICLE XXV 
 INDEMNIFICATION 
 
 25.1 Indemnification by the Franchisor: The Franchisor shall indemnify and hold the Franchisee (and the Franchisee's agents, principals, partners, members, shareholders, officers, directors, and employees) forever harmless from and against all liabilities, losses, claims, damages, costs and expenses (including, but not limited to, reasonable attorneys' fees and expenses) which are not covered by insurance proceeds that may be incurred by or asserted against any such Party and that arise from : (a) fraud, wilful misconduct or gross negligence of the Franchisor; provided, however, that the act or omission of any employee of the Franchisor who is not an Executive Employee, which act or omission is wilful or constitutes fraud or gross negligence on the part of such employee, shall not constitute fraud, gross negligence or wilful misconduct on the part of the Franchisor unless Franchisor's home office or regional staff, or an Executive Employee, acted with gross negligence in employing, training, supervising or continuing the employment of such employee; (b) the infringement by any of the Franchisor's Intellectual Property rights (including trademarks, software, etc.) on the intellectual property rights of any third party; (c) any Excluded Employee Claims; (d) knowing or reckless placing, discharge, leakage, use or storage, of hazardous materials on the Hotel by the Franchis or during the Term ; or ( f ) the breach by the Franchisor of any provision of this Agreement, including, without limitation, any action taken by the Franchisor which is beyond the scope of the Franchisor's authority under this Agreement, which is not cured within any applicable Notice and cure periods. The Franchisee shall promptly provide the Franchisor with written Notice of any claim or suit brought against it by a third party which might result in such indemnification. 
 
 25.2 Indemnification by the Franchisee: Except with respect to the matters for which the Franchisor is obligated to provide indemnification pursuant to Section 25.1, the Franchisee shall indemnify and hold the Franchisor (and the Franchisor's agents, principals, partners, members, officers, directors, and employees) forever harmless from and against all liabilities, losses, claims, damages, costs and expenses (including, but not limited to, reasonable attorneys' fees and expenses) which are not covered by insurance proceeds and that may be incurred by or asserted against the Fra nchisor and that arise from or in connection with (a) the performance of the Franchisee's services under this Agreement; or (b) the condition or use of the Hotel, to the fullest extent permitted by law, including without limitation, any injury to person(s) or damage to property or business by reason of any cause whatsoever in or about the Hotel. The Franchisor shall promptly provide the Franchisee with written Notice of any claim or suit brought against it by a third party which might result in such indemnification. 
 
 25.3 Indemnification Procedure : The Indemnifying Party shall have the right, by serving Notice to the other Party , to assume the defence of any claim with respect to which the other Party is entitled to indemnification hereunder. If the Indemnifying Party gives such notice, ( i ) such defence shall be conducted by counsel selected by the Indemnifying Party and approved by the other Party , such approval not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed (provided, however, that the other Party's approval shall not be required with respect to counsel designated by the Indemnifying Party's insurer); (ii) so long as the Indemnifying Party is conducting such defence with reasonable diligence, the Indemnifying Party shall have the right to control such a defence and shall not be required to pay the fees or disbursements of any counsel engaged by the other Party for services rendered after the Indemnifying Party has given the Notice provided for above to the other Party, except if there is a conflict of interest between the Parties with respect to such claim or defence; and (iii) the Indemnifying Party shall have the right, without the consent of the other Party, to settle such claim, but only provided that such settlement involves only the payment of money, the Indemnifying Party pays all amounts due in connection with or by reason of such settlement and, as part thereof, the other Party is unconditionally released from all liability in respect of such claim. The other Party shall have the right to participate in the defence of such claim being defended by the Indemnifying Party at the expense of the other Party, but the Indemnifying Party shall have the right to control such defence (other than in the event of a conflict of interest between the parties with respect to such claim or defence). 
 
 25.4 In no event shall ( i ) the other Party settle any claim without the consent of the Indemnifying Party so long as the Indemnifying Party is conducting the defence thereof in accordance with this Agreement; or (ii) if a claim is covered by the Indemnifying Party's liability insurance, take or omit to take any action which would cause the insurer not to defend such claim or to disclaim liability in respect thereof. 
 
 25.5 Survival: The provisions of this Article shall survive Termination of this Agreement with respect to acts, omissions and occurrences arising during the Term. 
 
 
 ARTICLE XXVI 
 DISPUTE RESOLUTION AND GOVERNING LAW 
 
 26.1 This Agreement and its interpretation, validity and performance shall be governed by the laws of Pakistan. The Parties hereto agree that exclusive venue for any action in connection herewith shall be Lahore . 
 
 26.2 Any dispute arising in connection with the franchise , or this Agreement, shall be settled by the Franchisee and the Franchisor amicably, failing which the same shall be referred to arbitration under the Arbitration Act, 1940, and a single arbitrator shall be appointed by mutual consent of the Parties . If the Franchisor and the Franchisee fail to agree upon an agreeable arbitrator , each will appoint its own arbitrator , who shall then, if necessary appoint a neutral arbitrator . The venue of arbitration shall be Lahore . The decision of the arbitrator shall be final and binding upon the Parties. The arbitration proceedings initiated shall be concluded within 6 (six) months of such reference, failing which the courts of Pakistan shall have jurisdiction over any matter arising out of, or in connection with this Agreement or the franchise . 
 
 
 ARTICLE XXVII 
 TERM OF THE AGREEMENT 
 
 27.1 Term: The term shall commence from the date when the Hotel has started its operations for the purpose of this Agreement, the Termination Date shall be a date which falls at ten (10) years from signing of this Agreement /Effective Date . 
 
 27.2 Notwithstanding Termination , Clause 10. 6 , the last sentence of Clause 16.1, Articles XXIV, XXV, XXVI &amp; XXVII, and Clause 28. 8 shall continue to be in force and survive Termination . 
 
 
 ARTICLE XXVIII 
 MISCELLANEOUS 
 
 28.1 Right to make Agreement : Each Party warrants, with respect to itself, that neither the execution of this Agreement nor the finalization of the transactions contemplated herein shall violate any provision of law or judgment, writ, injunction, order or decree of any court or governmental authority having jurisdiction over it; result in or constitute a breach or default , incur any indenture, contract, other commitment or restriction to which it is a Party or by which it is bound , or require any consent, vote or approval which has not been given or taken. Each Party covenants that it has and will continue to have throughout the Term and any extensions thereof, the full right to enter into this Agreement and perform its obligations hereunder. 
 
 28.2 Failure to Perform: If either party at any time fails to make any payments as specified or required hereunder or fails to perform any other act required on its part to be made or performed hereunder without limitation, then the other Party after thirty (30) days' written Notice to the defaulting Party may (but shall not be obligated to) pay any such delinquent amount or perform any such other act on the defaulting party's Part. Any sums thus paid and all costs and expenses incurred in connection with the making of such payment or the proper performance of any such act, together with mark-up at six months KIBOR + 2 percentage points, from the date that such payment is made or such costs and expenses incurred, shall constitute a liquidated amount to be paid by the defaulting Party under this Agreement to the other party on demand. 
 
 28.3 Franchisor ’s Representative: The Franchisor may , in consultation with the Franchisee, appoint its finance/accounts representative, who shall have access to the financial data of the Hotel. 
 
 28.5 Headings: Headings of articles and sections are inserted only for convenience and are in no way to be construed as a limitation on the scope of the particular articles or sections to which they refer. 
 
 28. 6 Entire Agreement : This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties and supersedes all prior understandings and writings. 
 
 28. 7 Confidentiality: The Franchisor shall keep confidential all non-public information obtained in connection with the services rendered under this Agreement and shall not disclose any such information or use any such information except in furtherance of its duties under this Agreement or as may be required by applicable Legal Requirements or order by a court of competent jurisdiction. 
 
 28. 8 Modification : Any amendment, supplement or modification of this Agreement must be in writing signed by both Parties hereto. 
 
 28. 9 Counterparts : This Agreement may be executed in multiple counterparts, each of which is an original and all of which collectively constitute one instrument.
